label: A unique classical GOD_4 exists iff every GOD_4 is classical and a unique GOD_4 exists
paraphrase: For every case signature: there is a unique GOD_4 with the classical attributes if and only if every GOD_4 has the classical attributes and some GOD_4 is the only GOD_4. A premise-free comparison of encodings; it asserts none of the three statements.
